description_en: Queries all devices in an IoT data source group
description_zh: 查询IoT数据源组下的所有设备
name: ListDevice

parameters.description_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0".
parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.description_en: The page number to display in the returned results. Minimum value: 1.
parameters.description_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，最小取值是1。
parameters.help_en: The page number to display in the returned results. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，最小取值是1
parameters.name: num

parameters.description_en: The number of records to display per page in the returned results. Maximum value: 100.
parameters.description_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是100。
parameters.help_en: The number of records to display per page in the returned results. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是100
parameters.name: size

parameters.description_en: The identifier of the business chain.
parameters.help_en: The identifier of the business chain

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the IoT data source group

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the IoT device to query.
